request.description: Get complete employee details including all sections (basic_info, address, education, documents, business_vertical, work_experience, bank_details)

Update employee. All sections are optional. For arrays (education, documents):
- Include 'id' to update existing records
- Omit 'id' to create new records
- Records not in the array will be deleted
Soft delete an employee and all related records (sets status to INACTIVE)
Mark attendance for an employee. Attendance status: 0=ABSENT, 1=PRESENT, 2=WFH. If attendance already exists for the date, it will be updated.
